items.question: How do I change my subscription plan?
items.answer_markdown: You can change your subscription plan by navigating to the **Subscription** page in your dashboard. From there, you can view available plans and select a new one. Changes take effect on your next delivery cycle.

items.question: How do I skip a delivery?
items.answer_markdown: To skip an upcoming delivery, please contact our support team at least 48 hours before your scheduled delivery date. We're working on adding self-service skip functionality soon!

items.question: What if I'm not home for my delivery?
items.answer_markdown: No worries! Our florists will leave your arrangement in a safe location at your property's designated delivery area. If you have specific instructions, please let your property manager know.

items.question: How do I contact support?
items.answer_markdown: You can reach our support team by email at [support@bloom.com](mailto:support@bloom.com?subject=Bloom%20Support). We typically respond within 24 hours on business days.

items.question: Can I change my delivery address?
items.answer_markdown: Bloom deliveries are tied to your property. If you've moved to a new property that participates in Bloom, please contact your **property manager** to update your account. If your new property doesn't have Bloom yet, ask them to get in touch with us!
